Harbor restoration plan

Transit engineers published the complete harbor restoration plan after reviewing the western support structure. The report explains the repair sequence, the public access route, and the next inspection date for residents.

  • Flood response

    Independent report on the flood response and its public timetable.

    The independent dispatch report documents the inspection route, confirmed repair sequence, and the public service schedule for residents.

    Officials list the responsible engineering teams, the next review date, and the contact process for people who need assistance.

    The notice also records which transport options remain available while crews complete work at the harbor.

    The cited update distinguishes confirmed findings from follow-up questions and explains where readers can review its source material.
